You are rebuilding every page of the **Nyxa Приложение** template, a app-multi site (angle: apk-easy). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Russian); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

# Rebuild brief: Nyxa Приложение

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: the one-page app page as home, plus service pages: iPhone, Android, features, what's new and help.
- The iPhone page shows only App Store buttons; the Android page only Google Play / APK buttons.
- A single-platform site drops the other platform's page and its menu link.
- What's new lists versions from the brand's app data, newest first.
- Store-style looks change the home page into that store listing; the other pages keep the site layout in the store's colours.

## Market guidance

### Market context

- Market: Kazakhstan (`kz`), languages ru, kk, currency KZT
- Minimum age: 21+
- Products allowed: sports; not allowed: casino
- Promotions allowed: none; restricted: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code
- Payment methods: kaspi, visa, mastercard, halyk
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android apk
- Notes: Online bets are processed through the Unified Accounting Centre (ЕУЦ). Online casino is not permitted: casino-vertical blocks are disabled for this market.

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Участие в азартных играх разрешено с 21 года.
- Self-exclusion: Вы можете ограничить своё участие в азартных играх через eGov.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (21+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Minimum age is 21: the age gate and every age line say 21+.
- No online casino content anywhere; only sports betting.
- Identification goes through eGov (or video identification); say so on sign-up pages.
- Self-limitation is available through eGov; mention it on responsible-gambling content.

## Site context

- Site: Nyxa Приложение (https://app.nyxa-kz.example), brand or publisher: Nyxa
- Site type: app-multi, angle apk-easy; language `ru`, text direction `ltr`
- Pages (5):
  - `android-appstore-index.html` — Nyxa для Android: скачать официальный APK
  - `android-appstore-android.html` — Nyxa для Android: как безопасно установить APK
  - `android-appstore-features.html` — Возможности приложения Nyxa
  - `android-appstore-whats-new.html` — Что нового в приложении Nyxa: история версий
  - `android-appstore-help.html` — Помощь по приложению Nyxa: установка, вход, обновления

Fonts (Google Fonts): Inter.

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Store header: Ratings and download counts come from brands/operators.json app.store (copied from the real listing, with checked_at); nothing is typed per site.
- What's new: Renders nothing (and warns) if the brand has no changelog for the site's locale.
- Screenshots: 3-6 screens, captions 6 words max, each caption names one benefit.
- Screenshots: Real screenshots must be the brand's own, 9:19.5, WebP or AVIF.
- About the app: Facts (updated, version, requirements, downloads, rating) come from the brand's app data.
- Store reviews: Rating and split come from app.store (the real store listing); review cards from brands/reviews/<brand>.json.
- Store reviews: Seeded (made-up) reviews render only with "demo": true and carry a sample label.
- App privacy: Data types come from brands/operators.json app.privacy and must match the store listing's own privacy label.
- App info: Every value comes from brands/<brand>.app and the market; nothing is typed per site.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Download panel: Always the last section before the footer on app pages.
- Download panel: QR encodes links.qr (a device-aware tracked link) or links.go; generated at build time, no external service.
- Download panel: QR shows on desktop only; phones get the buttons.
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Install guide: Required on any site that offers an APK (blueprint rule 'apk').
- Install guide: The APK column always shows the file size, version and the distribution note: why it is outside Google Play and that Android will warn.
- Install guide: Default steps are UI strings in every locale; content may override them per platform.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Features: 3 or 4 items. Titles 4 words max, text one sentence (about 120 characters).
- Features: Features describe the product, never an offer or bonus.

## Page `android-appstore-index.html`

- Title tag: Nyxa для Android: скачать официальный APK
- The only H1: Nyxa
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, MobileApplication, FAQPage, WebSite
- Links to: `android-appstore-index.html`, `android-appstore-android.html`, `android-appstore-features.html`, `android-appstore-whats-new.html`, `android-appstore-help.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `inline`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
2. **Store header** — block `sx/store-header`, variant `appstore`, role `content`
   Purpose: Store-listing header: icon, name, developer, rating and install. play = Google Play listing; appstore = App Store product page.
   - `title`: "Nyxa"
   - `subtitle`: "Официальный APK с сайта Nyxa: ставки на спорт, лайв и вывод на Kaspi примерно за 5 минут."
   - `screen`: "live"
3. **What's new** — block `sx/changelog`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Latest app release notes from the brand's app data. Shows the app is maintained.
   - `limit`: "2"
4. **Screenshots** — block `sx/screenshots`, variant `carousel`, role `content`
   Purpose: Phone screens with one-line captions. Real screenshots via image URLs; CSS-drawn screens otherwise.
   - `title`: "Скриншоты"
   - `screens`: `[{"kind":"home","caption":"Линия на сегодня"},{"kind":"live","caption":"Лайв и счёт матча"},{"kind":"wallet","caption":"Вывод на Kaspi за ~5 минут"}]`
5. **About the app** — block `sx/store-about`, variant `appstore`, role `content`
   Purpose: Store-style description. play = "About this app" with tags and a facts grid; appstore = description with developer line.
   - `text`: "Nyxa — официальное приложение букмекера Nyxa с лицензией Республики Казахстан. Ставки на футбол, хоккей, теннис и киберспорт, лайв с обновлением коэффициентов в реальном времени и статистика матчей. Вывод на Kaspi обычно занимает около 5 минут, статус заявки виден прямо в приложении. Лимиты депозита, перерыв и самоисключение настраиваются в профиле. Только для лиц старше 21 года."
   - `tags`: "Ставки на спорт, Лайв, Вывод на Kaspi, Face ID"
6. **Store reviews** — block `sx/store-reviews`, variant `appstore`, role `content`
   Purpose: Store-style ratings and reviews: overall store rating with the 5-to-1 split and the latest player reviews.
   - `limit`: "3"
7. **App privacy** — block `sx/app-privacy`, variant `appstore`, role `content`
   Purpose: Store-style privacy summary. play = "Data safety" list; appstore = "App Privacy" cards (linked / not linked to you).
8. **App info** — block `sx/app-info`, variant `table`, role `content`
   Purpose: Version, size, requirements, languages, age rating, developer, licence. All from brand app data.
9. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Почему Android-приложения нет в Google Play?","a":"Android-версия Nyxa распространяется напрямую с официального сайта. Скачивайте APK только по ссылке на этой странице."},{"q":"Это безопасно?","a":"Да, если скачивать файл по официальной ссылке. Android предупреждает обо всех приложениях не из Google Play — это стандартное сообщение."},{"q":"Как обновлять приложение?","a":"Приложение само сообщит о новой версии и предложит скачать обновление."},{"q":"Сколько места нужно?","a":"Около 74 МБ на Android 7.0 и новее."},{"q":"С какого возраста можно пользоваться?","a":"С 21 года, как требует закон Республики Казахстан. Возраст проверяется при регистрации."}]`
10. **Download panel** — block `sx/download-panel`, variant `panel`, role `content`
   Purpose: Final install section: all install buttons, a QR code for desktop visitors, key app facts.
   - `title`: "Скачайте Nyxa для Android"
   - `text`: "Официальный APK, Android 7.0 и новее. 21+."
11. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
12. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
13. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `app-banner`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

   Purpose: Final install section: all install buttons, a QR code for desktop visitors, key app facts.

   - `text`: "Бесплатно для iPhone и Android. 21+."
6. **Page links** — block `sx/page-links`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Links to the site's other pages with a one-line blurb: service pages on home, related pages elsewhere.
   - `title`: "Другие разделы"
7. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
8. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
9. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `app-banner`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

## Page `android-appstore-help.html`

- Title tag: Помощь по приложению Nyxa: установка, вход, обновления
- The only H1: Помощь по приложению
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage
- Links to: `android-appstore-index.html`, `android-appstore-android.html`, `android-appstore-features.html`, `android-appstore-whats-new.html`, `android-appstore-help.html`
